#Aletheia #LocalGov

Confusing personal grievances (WHO) with systemic governance reform (WHAT), creating mutual administrative paralysis.

When institutional power is subverted for personal conflict, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. F_neg dominates via severe friction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Workplace harassment claims demand transparent, independent resolution without political interference.

The Unavoidable Lie: High-stakes lawsuits are purely about upholding administrative integrity rather than power.

When the mayor and police chief are feuding in a 73-page lawsuit, nobody wins except the lawyers.

A barricaded suspect turned on a police K-9 during a South Bay takedown, biting and ripping off part of his ear, according to Redondo Beach police.

K-9 Wouter was sent into a Redondo Beach home to help officers take the suspect into custody during a standoff earlier this week. The encounter left the Dutch Shepherd injured and in need of veterinary treatment.

Wouter was rushed to ACCESS Specialty Animal Hospital, where he is now recovering after the suspect allegedly bit the K-9 during the apprehension and tore off a portion of his ear, police said.
